pysolfc-freecell-12.instruction: Finish this FreeCell endgame: move all 12 remaining cards onto the four suit foundations.
pysolfc-freecell-12.rules: Foundations build upward by suit from Ace to King. Tableau sequences descend with alternating colors. Use empty tableau columns or the four free cells to uncover blocked cards. Drag cards; press Z to undo. Hints, solver, automatic play, and switching deals are disabled.

curriculum.difficulty_rationale: Four independent suit columns have a king blocker; the longer four-card columns require tracking an extra rank dependency. Author estimate, pending empirical calibration. Initial empty tableau columns: 4; empty free cells: 4; maximum column depth: 3.
